description: iMOD Python is Deltares' package for preparing and evaluating large MODFLOW groundwater models. It combines xarray, Pandas, GeoPandas, Dask and Rasterio to transform GIS and scientific inputs, assign wells, write model packages, split or regrid models and inspect water budgets or time series. Inputs include rasters, meshes and groundwater model settings; outputs include MODFLOW files, processed results and visualisations. Coverage is global and user-defined, with spatial discretisation and stress periods chosen for the application. Public source and package documentation are free under MIT. The README supports MODFLOW 6 structured and vertex-discretised grids but states that only LAK and UZF among the advanced stress packages are supported. It also says iMOD-WQ has been sunset. Those limits matter when reusing older or more complex groundwater models. The package can prepare water-supply and irrigation simulations, with a methodological relationship to the catalogue's MODFLOW API agricultural water-use package (model-modflow-api-agricultural-water-use-package). That relationship does not establish tested compatibility between the two extensions. No groundwater inputs or executables were downloaded.
